short: is the line of love: it shows how you love, and how easily people get close to you
text: Your heart line is the line of love. It runs across the top of your palm, just below the fingers, and shows how you love and how easily people get close to you.

short: a long heart line means an open, generous heart: love comes to you easily, and you give plenty back

short: a heart line of medium length means a steady heart: you give love freely without losing yourself, and your relationships grow warm and close

short: a shorter heart line means a private heart: love comes to you slowly, and it means more because you waited for it

short: its straight course shows you love in a direct, honest way: you say what you feel, and the people close to you trust you

short: its gentle curve shows you are warm and easy to be around: people feel at home with you, and affection follows you

short: is the line of the mind: it shows how you think, what you are curious about, and where your ideas will take you
text: Your head line is the line of the mind. It runs across the middle of your palm, starting between your thumb and index finger. It shows how you think, what you are curious about, and where your ideas will take you.

short: a long head line means a thorough mind that sees the whole picture: your ideas will take you far

short: a head line of medium length means a mind that is both practical and imaginative: you will find a way through almost any problem

short: is the line of your energy: it shows how much drive you carry and how well you handle change
text: Your life line curves around the base of your thumb. It is the line of your energy: it shows how much drive you carry and how well you handle change. It is not a clock, and it says nothing about how many years anyone will have.

text: Your fate line is the line of direction. It rises up the middle of your palm and shows what you are aiming for in life and how your path takes shape. Many hands have no clear fate line, and that does not mean anything is missing: it just means your path is yours to make.
